proposed_capability: Moonwake Fifth Gear P95→P82→P08→P07→P124: Add an offline, capture-bound world-target highlight continuity and learning evaluator, distinct from fixed UI click coordinate scoring. Classify highlight loss and camera/identity drift, verify independently observed world-click outcomes, train bounded online Bayesian success estimates over portable context/strategies and gate opt-in host_stack world targeting without actuation. Reuse camera_traverse, lot_boundary and scene contracts; no new cursor worker.
player_save_control_impact: Opt-in read-only evidence and model advisory; no SendInput, auto navigation, game/save writes, profile discovery, agent escalation, OS or peripheral changes. Every actual action requires existing independent player/scene/save/lot/peripheral permits. Private captures remain local; deterministic bounded model exported only on explicit CLI invocation.
expected_outcome: World highlight lock/loss/ambiguity evaluation, online labelled outcome learner and heldout scorecard; opt-in world_target highlight_frames check in existing host_stack so unhighlighted objects cannot become click candidates; tests for camera revisions, occlusion, transient flicker, wrong target, spoofed source, player presence and model abstention. CLI reports and provider CI checks; preserve ongoing BI-002 game gate.
negative_tests: Absent highlight on two fresh captures must stop, never auto-reclick
Any camera revision or target identity mismatch revokes click candidate
Single frame, conflicting cues or unknown source abstain
Low-data learned accuracy never issues control permit
Wrong target or missing independent post-click evidence cannot train a success
Player busy, off-lot, scene/save uncertainty remain existing hard blocks
No secrets, screenshots, input effects, OS/peripheral mutations or profile name features
rollback_path: Revert owned branch or merge commit; opt-in world_target highlight_frames is absent by default; existing camera framing and independent host permissions remain authoritative. Keep BI-002 ACTIVE.
unresolved_unknowns: No local Windows Sims runtime attached for P08 live capture and independently observed real-world click outcomes
Highlight cues are provided by trusted host sensors; this is an evidence evaluator, not a pretrained screenshot detector
PR #159 host spatial-perception integration remains independently owned and must be reconciled without overwriting host_listener
decision_rationale: Select incremental evaluator and bounded online learner in existing host-side decision path, separate from fixed UI and current PR159 perception lane; P08 actual Sims runtime proof remains an explicit independent acceptance gate.
